reserveReview.rationale: The September 30 USDGO Reserve Report discloses $99,987,265 STBXX, $525,173,013 JLTXX, $515,535,803 BUIDL and $50,997,715 cash, totaling $1,191,693,796. These dated balances normalize to the curated percentages, rounded to six decimals.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Deloitte examination of the USDGO Reserve Report as of September 30, 2026; Schedule II balances normalized by $1,191,693,796 total reserve assets.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The report discloses the two money market fund CUSIPs; their names are verified against the fund managers' product pages. Underlying fund portfolios and account-level custodians remain outside the report's disclosed scope.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The September report confirms segregated, unencumbered fiduciary trust accounts for token holders and Anchorage's self-custody of $515,535,803 BUIDL on Solana. It identifies 9yGxs2pSFFBZhJVrwRAgbKHaLQnuHa7BpmCRsHuzG968, but does not name the banks holding $50,997,715 cash or the money market funds' account-level custodians. Anchorage's provider share is not disclosed; no 100% custody allocation is assumed. A standing rehypothecation policy and report-time wallet balances remain unverified.
